facts.text: I have been cooking at home lately.
I cooked dinner at home five out of seven nights in the last week.
I am looking for healthy lunch ideas.
I want healthy alternatives to sugar for baking and cooking.
I have been experimenting with honey lately.
I have been experimenting with coconut sugar lately.
I like the caramel-like flavor of coconut sugar in my oatmeal and yogurt.
I usually add sliced banana to my oatmeal and yogurt.
I usually add a sprinkle of cinnamon to my oatmeal and yogurt.
Sometimes I add chopped nuts like walnuts or almonds to my oatmeal and yogurt.
I find that the sweetness from honey and coconut sugar is enough.
I do not need to add any other sweetener.
I have been trying to meal prep more.
I want tips on how to store cooked food safely and keep it fresh for a longer period.
I have been trying to reduce food waste by planning my meals out more carefully and using up leftover ingredients.
Last week, I made a big pot of chicken soup.
Last week, I used leftover chicken from chicken soup to make chicken salad for lunch the next day.
I freeze individual portions of cooked vegetables and meat to use in future meals.
